text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Leave those materials over there! Right now,
I'm sorting 'em into sections so they're easier to use.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I see, "seeds must be strictly planted separately"... got it! Taking notes, taking notes!
The deserted island project was progressing smoothly! Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I want to build relaxation facilities on the island!
Yet, lost in thought, I find myself trapped in a massive maze!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: A spa, a cafe, or an amusement park—either way, I'd like a variety of opinions!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A spa, a cafe, an amusement park... I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hup... Haaah... it's way too far. And there's nobody around.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (...It's not quite a tropical vacation, but I joined in because I wanted to go somewhere with fewer people—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(At first, I thought having nothing at all would be the best,
but... in the end, there's always someone around here, isn't there?)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (Development is moving along. There will probably be more and more people from now on, so in the end... there's no such thing as a place completely hidden from sight...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at Gold City...!
I didn't know she could smile so innocently like that.
Whoa! I took a picture...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Dammit.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...Ugh, seriously, stop moping around. It's so lame.
Modeling was your own choice, wasn't it...?!)
(*Rumble...*)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...The sound of water...
A river? Or maybe a lake—?)
(Tick tick tick tick...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (What is this place? Completely untouched, purely natural... Incredible...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fufu... The wind feels so go—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Crap, feeling good from connecting with nature?
Talk about out of character, how embarrassing!
If anyone saw me—)
(Tick tick tick tick...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...—
Dummy, there's... no one around right now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll rest for just a bit.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...—I hear so many sounds.
And wow, the water's so clear. There are fish too—)
(PLOP――flump)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah... My fish got taken.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...There's a rabbit. Covered in mud.
And pill bugs, ants. A fallen cicada.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(............
There are birds flying again.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Just living as I am,
flying, eating... just existing...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (Ha, no. I'm letting the atmosphere get to me too much. Of course I am.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Those kids are living creatures.
They live completely bare, just as they are.
So that's—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ............Must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at Gold City...!
I didn't know she could smile so innocently like that.
Whoa! I took a picture...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...I care too much every single day.
Always dressing up, constantly trying to act cool—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I don't have to strip down completely naked...
If only I could just take off one more layer. At least one.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's City!
Time for lunch—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, haha! What's with you?
You're totally zoning out there.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Z-Zoned out!?
N-Not really—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I get it. This island is just so... soothing, or maybe liberating, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"So it makes ya feel at ease.
Must be an instinct of livin' things, huh."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even the cool and handsome Gold City's
only human after all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that about?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No, um... Right.
I'm a living creature too... aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, obviously...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ha... haha! That's hilarious!
Haaah... hehe!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —The breeze feels nice, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"There's no need to build relaxation facilities."
—What made you think that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh......
Nah, I think the way things are right now is totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho! Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...There are plenty of spas and cafes back over there.
On the other hand, you can't find this kind of nature anywhere else.
It's rare... and so soothing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even if we do it, wouldn't it be better
to make use of the current setup?"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I seeee, how very intriguing!
If we build on its current form—yes, isn't that splendid!
This opens up so many possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Seems I was far too obsessed with the act of creation itself!
Thank you, City!"

—The deserted island project
progressed smoothly!
